summary: Jefferson County, WA lookout: AWS cabin 1942, 35-ft wooden platform and house 1949, removed 1958; FFLOS-registered 2012; summit now trees, no remains found.

facts.design: AWS cabin (1942), replaced in 1949 by a 35-foot wooden platform and house
facts.status_note: Removed or destroyed in 1958 (1957 per a 1962 paper quoted by WillhiteWeb); WillhiteWeb found no remains at the summit

visit.trail_note: WillhiteWeb: about 2 miles and 240 ft of climb; a gated dirt road off Thorndyke Road, then a faint skid road up the tree line toward the top

events.note: 35-foot wooden platform and house replaced the cabin; May 1949 Port Townsend Leader report quoted by WillhiteWeb
Register: removed; Firelookout: destroyed; WillhiteWeb: removed or destroyed. A 1962 paper quoted by WillhiteWeb dates the dismantling to 1957
Registered January 20, 2012 as US 1207, WA 108; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says removed in 1958, Firelookout says destroyed in 1958, WillhiteWeb says removed or destroyed in 1958. WillhiteWeb also quotes a 1962 paper dating the dismantling to 1957. The story gives 1958 and notes the 1957 report.

notes_for_editor: Brief access 'unknown' is kept out of facts; the route crosses a gate that a photo caption ties to Olympic Resource Management, and no source says whether the public may cross it. The 35-foot figure is not clearly a height, so no height_m is given. Brief elevation 154.8 m matches the register's 508 ft (155 m). No WebSearch used; the register, Firelookout and WillhiteWeb agree on the core dates.
